title: CharacterContinuityCanon
description: Strict schema locking visual identity, 2D/3D style tags, wardrobe states, and signature props across Dual-Mode I2V and R2V animation pipelines.

character_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the character (e.g., 'pip_stone_age_penguin').

aesthetic_medium.description: Primary animation medium used to route anti-style-drift negative guards.

focal_anchor.description: Concise subject reference (3-10 words) used in Mode A (First-Frame I2V) to isolate the subject without conflicting with the first-frame embedding (e.g., 'The small plump Stone Age penguin in the fur tunic').

locked_identity_block.description: Immutable 20-25 word physical & wardrobe description pasted VERBATIM at index 0 of every Mode B (R2V) prompt. Synonym swapping is strictly forbidden.

style_lock_tags.description: Strictly capped at 4 tags so style tokens do not starve the motion attention budget (e.g., ['2D flat cel-shaded cartoon style', 'clean bold dark outlines', 'warm earthy prehistoric palette', 'European-North American TV animation look']).

consistency_anchor.default: consistent 2D animation style throughout, no style shift, uniform color palette, continuous seamless shot
consistency_anchor.description: Mandatory closing tag appended to the end of every positive prompt.

head_to_body_ratio.description: Locked proportion ratio (e.g., '1:2 chibi proportion', 'compact rounded avian torso').

facial_markers.description: Immutable facial features (e.g., ['large expressive round eyes', 'short triangular orange beak', 'white cheek patches']).

verbatim_descriptor.description: Exact phrasing for the outfit (e.g., 'wearing a ragged mammoth-fur sash slung over one shoulder with a bone clasp').
Exact phrasing for the prop (e.g., 'holding a wooden-shafted chipped flint hand-axe tied with leather cord').

master_front_sheet.description: Path to primary high-res character asset.

clean_bg_reference.description: Path to background-removed asset for IP-Adapter/Phantom/VACE.

cropped_medium_closeup.description: Pre-cropped upper-body asset for portrait/dialogue shots.
